summary: Avalanche struck the home of Hinsdale County sheriff Justin Casey and his two daughters on County Road 30 in Lake City at ~6:40 a.m. Tuesday, destroying the home; all three injured (minor to critical); ~15 rescuers (SAR, police, fire, EMS, road-and-bridge) located and evacuated them within about an hour; a second avalanche on the same road before noon involved no one; Gunnison County sheriff + deputies drove in to assist; voluntary evacuations recommended county-wide
responding_agency: Hinsdale County SAR + law enforcement/fire/EMS; Gunnison County Sheriff's Office assisting
notes: CBN article by Katherine Nettles; sheriff hospitalized in Gunnison; date weekday-verified Tuesday; RESOLVES the run-156/run-140 pending lead; date entered from the article (early morning of Tuesday, March 12, 2019)
